thread:
maya.sales: Halcyon Health sent an RFI asking for a HIPAA-capable POC, quantization impact guidance, and a short commercial summary. PDF attached: https://drive.company/halcyon_rfi.pdf. Can someone take tech + sec bullets?

ci-bot: Uploaded file `halcyon_rfi.pdf` (1.2MB) to #sales thread.

owen.eng: I can handle model/infra answers. Short plan: offer 2-stage POC — Stage A hosted fp16 baseline (7-10 days) then Stage B Dedicated quantized run (int8 or int4 depending on model) for cost/latency comparison. Provide simple test harness and eval script.

tess.security: Security notes: require signed BAA/DPA before PHI ingest. For hosted POC we enable isolated tenant, customer-managed KMS, and 30d audit logs. For Private/HSM we can integrate customer HSMs (SOW). Will include a short checklist for data handling and log redaction.

mike.finance: Pricing suggestion: one-time POC credit $7,500 covering hosted work and first 300GB egress. Dedicated short-term commit starting $18k/mo (30-day min). Egress overage $0.10/GB. Include optional support add-on at $200/hr.

maya.sales: Can someone draft single-line answers I can paste into their RFI fields? Need: ingestion method, residency, KMS, retention, egress, executive blurb, attachments list.

owen.eng: Drafts below — edit as needed.

- Ingestion: Customer may provide presigned S3 URLs or cross-account read role; we recommend presigned URLs (24h TTL) for one-off uploads.
- Residency: Hosted POC data stored in chosen region; Private/VPC supports on-prem or region-restricted hosting.
- KMS/HSM: Support for customer-managed KMS for hosted POCs; HSM-backed keys available in Private or on-prem deployments with SOW.
- Retention: Default 14 days for POC artifacts; configurable shorter retention for sensitive datasets.
- Egress/billing: We cover first 300GB for the POC; additional egress billed at $0.10/GB. Private deployments follow customer's cloud egress billing.
- Exec blurb: "Redwood proposes a short two-stage POC to validate model fidelity and cost tradeoffs: quick hosted baseline followed by quantized Dedicated runs, with security controls and a final findings report."
- Attachments: pricing sheet, BAA/DPA, POC SOW template, quickstart eval harness.

tess.security: Tiny edits: require presigned URLs to be read-only and rotated for multiple batches; add contact tess.security@redwood.ai for questionnaire follow-ups. Also change retention default to 14 days hosted, 30 days audit logs.

mike.finance: Confirm pricing bullets. I'll upload the pricing sheet after this thread.

maya.sales: Great — assembling now, will send back the filled RFI by EOD. Thanks!
